metadata.bootstrap_scope: descriptive question-bootstrap model variation; not a confidence or prediction interval
metadata.limitations: single noisy outcomes and dependent actions; no adaptive or full-MAS coverage guarantee
metadata.primary_prediction: deterministic all-fit weighted ridge; clip/renormalize help and harm
metadata.standardization_scope: weighted current fit partition only; reused by bootstrap replicates
metadata.support_scope: observed role/hop/group-size metadata with selected_count=0; abstain otherwise
metadata.weight_scheme: equal question mass; equal episode mass within question; equal action mass within episode; sum=n_rows
